verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਨੀਵੀਂ ਹੋਇ ਚਰਣ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee neevee(n) hoi charan chit laiaa|

en.bdb: The earth becoming lowly concentrated on the feet (of Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval ras bhoi aap gavaiaa|

en.bdb: Being one with the joy of the lotus feet, it divested itself of the ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਰੇਣੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ਇਛ ਇਛਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: charan ren tih loi ichh ichhaiaa|

en.bdb: It is that dust of the feet, which is desired by the three worlds.
Fortitude and dutifulness added to it, the contentment is the basis of all.
It, considering the way of life of every creature, offers livelihood to all.
In accordance to the divine will, it behaves like a gurmukh does.
